title: CodeChef: End Sorted
description: Given a permutation `p` of numbers 1 to N, an operation allows swapping adjacent elements. What is the minimum operations to place 1 at index 0 and N at index N - 1?
solution:
def end_sorted_moves(p: list[int]) -> int:
    n = len(p)
    idx_1 = p.index(1)
    idx_n = p.index(n)
    moves = idx_1 + (n - 1 - idx_n)
    return moves - 1 if idx_1 > idx_n else moves
explanation: Indices to move 1 left and n right cross each other if 1 was originally to the right of n, saving 1 swap.
